note: LIB-12: New in a library category. The client mints command_id, so a retry after a lost response opens the document that was already made instead of making a second 'Untitled NPC'. The server records author gm. Documents made by a tool are created by the tool invocation, not by this.

valid.name: a new NPC, named Untitled with the name selected for typing
a handout started with a name and a tag

invalid.name: no name
invalid.why: LIB-12: nothing is stored until a document has a name

invalid.name: no campaign
invalid.why: RAIL-13: a document belongs to a campaign from its first moment

invalid.name: no command id
invalid.why: every Workbench mutation can be retried safely; without a key a retry makes a second document

invalid.name: a command id too short to be an idempotency key
invalid.why: 16..64 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-], like an invocation id

invalid.name: a document id chosen by the client
invalid.why: ids are the server's to mint; nothing on the wire may let a client aim at someone else's row

invalid.name: a type that does not exist
a field the type does not declare
invalid.why: invalid document fields fail closed, before anything is stored
